title: Personnel of Bricktop's band and Nelson Kincaide
summary: Briggs lists the band: Freddie Johnson, Briggs, Billy Taylor, Herb Fleming, Big Boy Goodie, du Conge and Nelson Kincaide, who arranged and rehearsed the choir.

story.theme_name: Who was in the band: naming sidemen and personnel
story.community_name: Who played in the band: reciting personnel

blocks.x: Well, let me finish -- before you go ahead, I wanted to get a little bit about Peter Du Conge. You said that he was a New Orleans guy?

Yes, he was from New Orleans, right, yes, yes. Well, I'm going to tell you about him. Now, I tell you that Bricktop hired us all, right, and Peter was her husband, he was a member of the orchestra, naturally.
And there was Freddie Johnson, Arthur Briggs, Billy Taylor, and I can't remember who was on bass now -- Herb Fleming --
Herb Fleming on trombone. And Big Boy Goodie, tenor. And
Nelson Kincaide who made the arrangements for the choir and everything else. As I told you, we had a -- Mabel Mercer, and -- what's the name of that singer -- Bert Marshall.
Yeh. And Louie Cole. Louie Cole was a member of the Blackbirds and stayed, and Peter du Conge, naturally.
And was du Conge the leader of the band, or --
No, Nelson Kincaide was the leader.
Yes. 'Cause he made the arrangements for the singers and everything, you see. He was the one who incorporated the band, but Nelson Kincaide was responsible for the show.
He rehearsed the singers and everything else. He made the arrangements and rehearsed the singers, and automatically accompanied the players.
